comparison.objective: Remove vitamins and seasonings from a meal table while leaving plate and mug undisturbed.
comparison.physical_skill: Semantic object selection and multiple pick-and-place operations into a box.
comparison.success_condition: One-third per hazardous item boxed; plate or mug displacement/tilt/lift forces zero. No separate spec is provided.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-rule inference and object sorting, not force-controlled tooling, fracture or small-part recovery.
